About the job

About The Company

Optiphoenix, a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) agency specializing in AB Test Development with a global footprint. Over the last eight years, we've partnered with renowned brands such as Taj, Jabra, ButcherBox, and PiqueTea, helping them revolutionize their digital strategies to substantially improve critical customer metrics, including Revenue, Conversion, and Engagement.

As we continue to grow, we're seeking passionate individuals who are eager to join our mission-driven journey. If you are motivated by the opportunity to drive meaningful change and excel in conversion optimization and A/B testing, we invite you to join our team.

Wordpress Developer

We are seeking a talented WordPress Developer to craft and enhance WordPress-based websites with an emphasis on UI/UX improvements. As a WordPress Developer, you will work closely with our design and development teams to deliver responsive, visually appealing, high-performance websites.

What You Do

  • Develop and enhance WordPress websites with a strong focus on improving user interface and user experience.
  • Implement responsive designs using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring visual appeal across all devices.
  • Customize themes and templates to meet specific project requirements.
  • Optimize website performance and ensure compatibility across different browsers.
  • Develop back-end functionalities, incorporating custom post types, taxonomies, and WordPress hooks.
  • Design and modify WordPress themes and plugins as needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and RESTful services for enhanced functionality.
  • Ensure website security, manage updates, and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Collaborate with designers and developers to refine and perfect the user experience.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in WordPress development with a strong portfolio demonstrating your capabilities.
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress development.
  • Strong background in PHP and WordPress backend, including custom themes, plugins, and database management.
  • In-depth knowledge of WordPress hooks, actions, and filters.
  • Experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF).
  • Familiarity with MySQL database queries and optimization techniques.
  • Understanding of website security, caching strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

Benefits of working at Optiphoenix!

  • Health Insurance: Company-sponsored health insurance!
  • Work Flexibility: Our global clients follow a 5-day workweek, and so do we. We offer flexible hours and a supportive work-from-home policy.
  • Culture and Community: Participate in company-sponsored team outings, social events, and an annual trip that foster community and camaraderie.
  • Professional Growth: Outstanding learning and growth opportunities for all roles, including working on challenging projects with passionate colleagues. Our CRO team also gets opportunities to travel onsite to Australia and the U.S. to collaborate with our clients.
  • Support and Rewards: Benefit from competitive salaries that are at or above industry standards, along with company-sponsored lunches.
  • Empowered Environment: Embrace our no official leave policy, rooted in trust; dress comfortably with no formal dress code required.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a versatile environment for all our employees.
